findings.claim: probe22 benchmark: 1,283 manifest items/18 langs; 1,227 scored by 10 local engines (11 model strings) = 12,324 sheet.csv rows; Sarvam ran on only 54 (3 per language x 18). All items printed, no tables, no mixed-script (printed-only; no handwriting in this corpus).
South: 400 labelled pages (ta/te/kn/ml x100) but only 126 carry a CER (219 nulled gt_thin GT<200 chars, 55 nulled legacy mojibake). gt_thin threshold is 200 chars in verify_v2.py, not 179.

22-language table: 13 of 22 languages have scored n>=50; ml n=5 below lead's 5-10 floor; 8 more at n 19-37 carry no winner claim. Low-n: as 19, mni 20, sat 20, gu 24, doi 27, ne 37, kn 25, te 26, ml 5.

Best local engine among 12 languages with n>=50: surya wins 9, tesseract-family 2, easyocr 1. Winner CERs: ur 0.6232, ks 0.5894, bn 0.4763, kok 0.4248, sd 0.3155, or 0.2588, hi 0.2198, mr 0.2047, sa 0.1751, brx 0.1653, pa 0.1447, mai 0.0298; 7 of 12 in 0.10-0.40 band.

Sarvam comparison n=54 (3/lang) is DIRECTIONAL: surya mean CER lower in 10 of 18 langs; item-level Sarvam better 28, surya 21, tie 5. Sarvam mean CER 0.2640, best local 0.2956, surya overall 0.3944. McNemar p<0.05 only in 5 langs (bn, brx, hi, kok, ks); ur 0 of 9.

'We lead on 10/18' is a PDF-text-layer GT artefact. GT-tier split on 54 paired items (Sarvam CER / best-local): pair_txt n=9 0.0641/0.2425; pdf_layer n=36 0.3105/0.2285; sarvam_bench n=9 0.2781/0.6167. All 21 item-level surya wins sit in PDF-layer tier, 0 in either human-verified tier. Pooled human-verified n=18: Sarvam 0.171 vs local 0.430 = 2.51x; surya-always 3.70x (0.171 vs 0.632); excluding mni/sat 2.02x (0.132 vs 0.265).

Sarvam headline 87.39 is a word-accuracy-style macro-average over 22 languages with English excluded, on a benchmark Sarvam built and scored itself; NOT comparable to our CER (different metric/items/normalisation).

COMPETITOR_INTEL corrections: Bodhan ~0.83B released 5 Sep 2026 and 84.94 is Sarvam's score for Bodhan; 'OldScan 55.3' is an English olmOCR-Bench category, not a language; indic-ocr-bench card says GT reviewed twice by human language experts (so 'machine GT' label wrong; mni/sat BARRED verdicts likely verifier-competence artefact).
